elements.name: night street under deep blue sky
two young men walking side by side away from viewer
shorter young man with backpack on the left
taller young man in blue denim jacket with empty hands on the right
tall concrete buildings with many lit windows
crowds of people as soft dark shapes on both sides

wrong_setting: Ornate pastel European-style townhouses with shopfront awnings, vintage European cars and a cobbled old-town street read as a European city at dusk, not the concrete-building edge of Addis Ababa at night; the sky is a pale amber haze rather than deep blue.
notes: Regenerate with both young men walking side by side: the curly-haired one on the left in a dark jacket with his simple backpack and closed-toe buckle sandals, and the taller one on the right in a denim jacket with empty hands. Set them on a night Addis Ababa road under a deep blue sky, with concrete buildings and blue-and-white minibus taxis, instead of this single merged figure in a European dusk street.
